snippet.title: Frosthaven | 1.0 Release Date Reveal Trailer - Releases October 15, 2026
snippet.description:
Play Frotshaven on Steam now: https://bit.ly/4ujmQ6X

We're excited to announce that FROSTHAVEN, the digital adaptation of the critically-acclaimed board game by Isaac Childres and Cephalofair Games, will officially launch on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on October 15, 2026!

Snapshot Games CEO Julian Gollop and Game Director Hristo Petkov reveal the official release date in this video, detailing FROSTHAVEN’s Early Access evolution thanks to player feedback and what you can expect with the game’s full release in the fall. 

Wishlist Frosthaven today and get notified immediately when the full 1.0 version of the game is available! 
Steam: https://bit.ly/4ujmQ6X
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/frosthaven-0aa6b6?lang=en-US

Watch: https://www.youtube.com/@PlayFrosthaven
Follow: https://x.com/PlayFrosthaven 
Like: https://www.facebook.com/FrosthavenGame 
Discuss: https://discord.gg/FUNmzWVfz2
